records.text: A woman from Dassel, Minnesota claimed that she, rather than Erika Kirk, was with Lori Frantzve when Lori learned Charlie Kirk had been shot.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: OK, and lastly, we were given the name of a woman from Dassault, Minnesota, who has claimed that she and not Erica (Erika Kirk) was with Lori (Lori Frantzve) when when Lori (Lori Frantzve) got the news that her son-in-law had been shot again.

verification.notes: The transcript references an unnamed woman from Dassel and a private claim about Lori Frantzve. No identity, direct statement, or public record was available for independent verification.
